= Equipment Dashboard =

This page provides an overview of all equipment in the lab, including maintenance schedules and calibration status.

== Equipment Needing Maintenance ==

Equipment with maintenance due within the next 30 days:

{{#ask:

[[Status::Active]]
|?Last Maintenance Date
|?Next Calibration Date
|?Equipment Location
|?Owner
|format=table
|link=all
|headers=plain
|mainlabel=Equipment
|order=ASC
|sort=Last Maintenance Date
|limit=50
}}
